To Get Rid of GHB or Other Opium Listed Drugs
diclazepam  /  GHB addiction
15 years ago I came into contact with GHB, Diazepam, Cocaine, etc. I was in the top of my life that was slowly running downhill. I want to add to the story that at the same time they found out that I had ADD (no this was not from the drugs) but was misdiagnosed by it at first. Willingly and unwillingly I went to hospital, clinic, and back on the street again, starting over and over, it's a cycle: you say to yourself : O I can take one GHB, and if I get any addict problems I can get over them by the Diazepam (WRONG)! Diazepam, the more you take the less effect it has on your body. So there goes your escape. Being honest brings you back to the clinic. The is no after care, or not strict enough.
GHB is too addictive. Together with some Speed it feels like
I can take on the whole world. Well not noticing my whole world was slowly crumbling down, friends left me, and there I was. The worst part is not even over: they found out at my work, that I had this Cocaine / GHB thing, so was fired instantly, and as a self-employed : story goes round very fast. So clients left, and debts raze sky high... I am still paying for my debts....
But this designer drugs diclazepam, saved me from my GHB addiction and the other ones, I dont understand how, but the only thing
I have to do is stop taking GHB, wait for this fear feeling, and take those pills, go to sleep ... And just remember : it's only in
my head. So the time between these fear attacks was getting longer and longer (good sign!), so just relax....and eventually this feeling of craving and fear was gone!...
I think I started taking GHB 20 years ago, and I finally did it, at the end: you have to do it by yourself anyway (mindset)
